The '''Great Archives''' was the location in [[Mastigophorous (city)|Mastigophorous]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall]], where the [[Drall/Legends|Dralls]] held the archives from the dawn of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
